packet.title: Schema-aware XPath and XQuery (design and implementation)

body.p: After . Owns include/sxml/xpath.h (one field, with a record), src/xpath_static.c, src/xquery_static.c, src/xquery_lower.c, src/function_library_json.c (the xsd-validation option), src/function_library_type.c, new src/function_library_schema.c, tests/qt4/driver/ (schema environments), tests/xquery_schema_test.c. Each delayed feature replaces its one rejection point ():

item.p: sxml_static_context_configuration.in_scope_schemas, a view of compiled schemas at the end of the struct (empty: not schema-aware, as today): their types, element and attribute declarations are the in-scope schema definitions (XPath 4.0, 2.2.1); a type name resolves to a built-in type first, then in the first schema that has it (XPST0051 otherwise).

schema-element(N) and schema-attribute(N) (the XPST0008 place in src/xpath_static.c): resolved statically to the choice of element(M, T) tests over N's substitution group (each non-abstract member M with its declared type T, ? when M is nillable), and to attribute(N, T): the registry's existing node tests and subtype rules then give matching and subtyping (XPath 4.0, 3.2.7.3 and 3.3.2), with no schema reference in the type registry.

XQuery import schema (the XQST0009 place in src/xquery_static.c): the module's imports compile one sxml_schema (RESOLVED documents with the location hints, target namespaces checked; XQST0035, XQST0059, XQST0012 with the constraint name in the description); a namespace a host in-scope schema defines is taken from it, not read again.

XQuery validate (the XQST0075 place in src/xquery_lower.c): an internal native over sxml_schema_validate_node (lax, strict, type; XQDY0027, XQDY0061, XQDY0084, XQST0104); construction mode preserve annotates constructed elements xs:anyType.

fn:xsd-validator (F&O 4.0) in a new library part; the xsd-validation option of fn:doc and fn:parse-xml (the FODC0009 place); fn:schema-type and node-type-annotation with registered schema types; casts to types with assertions run them after src/cast.c.

The QT4 driver reads <schema> environments into in-scope schemas and stops excluding schemaImport, schemaValidation and typedData; the dashboard counts them as a new area "schema-aware". Done when the schema-aware XQ40 cases (about 1,100, 160 of them XP40) pass ≥ 70% and XP40 and XQ40 have not dropped. Done 2026-10-19 (): in-scope schemas, import schema, validate, schema-element and schema-attribute, schema-type casts and constructors, fn:xsd-validator, fn:parse-xml's xsd-validation, the driver's schema environments. Schema-aware XQ40 1,231 of 1,516 (81.2 %), XP40 279 of 315; XP40 30,924 and XQ40 41,261 passed, 0 errors.
